Our Story

Founded in 2015 in Idaho Falls, Imperial Cleaning Inc. began with a simple mission: to provide the highest quality cleaning services that construction companies and businesses could truly rely on.

What started as a local Idaho Falls operation has grown into the region's most trusted cleaning company, serving clients across Idaho and Utah. Our success stems from our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.

Today, with over 2,500 completed projects and a team of 25+ professionals, we continue to set the standard for cleaning excellence in the Intermountain West.
